description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbukgolla, Kumbukgolla D/S Division, Mathale District - Cad. Map No. 310107(23/1200125)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title settlement, cadastral maps, and determination of land ownership in specific districts and villages. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land ownership, possession interests, and title settlement procedures.
